question: What was our total net revenue in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_inr), 2) FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_month) = 2025

question: Which region had the highest revenue in 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT r.name, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr), 2) FROM sales s JOIN distributors d USING (distributor_id) JOIN regions r USING (region_id) WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2024 GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units of Mango Kulfi did we sell in the West region in 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(s.units) FROM sales s JOIN distributors d USING (distributor_id) WHERE s.sku = 'FF-KUL-MNG-60' AND d.region_id = 'WEST' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2024

question: Top 5 products by units sold in 2025
reference_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(s.units) FROM sales s JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show monthly revenue for 2025
reference_sql: SELECT sale_month, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_inr), 2) FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_month) = 2025 GROUP BY sale_month ORDER BY sale_month

question: Revenue by channel in 2025
reference_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_inr), 2) FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_month) = 2025 GROUP BY channel

question: How much discount did we give on the Classic Vanilla Tub through quick commerce in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_inr), 2) FROM sales WHERE sku = 'FF-TUB-VAN-500' AND channel = 'quick_commerce' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_month) = 2025

question: Which product had the lowest net revenue in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr), 2) FROM sales s JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 1

question: Compare total revenue in 2024 vs 2025
reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_month)::int, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_inr), 2) FROM sales GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: How many active products do we have?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE status = 'active'

question: How many quality incidents were high severity?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_incidents WHERE severity = 'high'

question: How many distributors are in the East region?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distributors WHERE region_id = 'EAST'

question: What was the gross margin on Choco Bar in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr - s.units * p.unit_cost_inr), 2) FROM sales s JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE p.name = 'Choco Bar' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025

question: Net revenue by product category in Q2 2025
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr), 2) FROM sales s JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE s.sale_month >= '2025-04-01' AND s.sale_month < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY p.category

question: How many units did the Pune Plant produce in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(units) FROM production_batches WHERE plant_id = 'P02' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM produced_on) = 2025

question: Which distributor had the highest revenue in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT d.name, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr), 2) FROM sales s JOIN distributors d USING (distributor_id) WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025 GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units of kulfi were sold in May 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(s.units) FROM sales s JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE p.category = 'kulfi' AND s.sale_month = '2025-05-01'

question: Which distributor grew revenue the most from 2024 to 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT d.name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025 THEN s.net_revenue_inr ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2024 THEN s.net_revenue_inr ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM sales s JOIN distributors d USING (distributor_id) GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What share of 2025 revenue came from quick commerce?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(net_revenue_inr) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'quick_commerce') / SUM(net_revenue_inr), 1) FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_month) = 2025

question: Revenue of Lemon Mint Sorbet by region
